zh: 通过应用商店优化（ASO）、首次使用体验（FRE）和应用内引导的改进，完善新用户体验。
突出国际版与国内版的模式切换入口，让切换更直观、易用。
引入更多动效，打造更流畅、愉悦的使用体验，提升用户参与度。
en: We are enhancing the onboarding experience by optimizing ASO, improving app FRE, and refining in-app user guidance.
Additionally, we are highlighting the global/domestic mode switcher and making it more intuitive and user-friendly.
To further elevate engagement, we are introducing more motion elements to create a smoother, more delightful user experience.
